name: Typer codebase evaluation
notes: Ground truth is aligned to this Typer checkout and to method-level AST chunks with qualified names.

questions.question: How is a Typer application created?
important_facts: Typer is the main application class.

questions.question: Where is the `Typer` class implemented?
important_facts: Typer is implemented in typer/main.py.

questions.question: How are CLI commands registered?
important_facts: Typer.command is a decorator method on the Typer class.

questions.question: How does `@app.command()` work internally?
important_facts: The command method records command metadata and returns a decorator.

questions.question: Where is `@app.callback()` implemented?
important_facts: The callback decorator is implemented as a Typer class method.

questions.question: How are command-line arguments parsed?
important_facts: Command metadata becomes a Click command.
Parameter metadata becomes Click arguments or options.

questions.question: How does Typer convert function parameters into CLI options?
important_facts: Function parameter metadata and converters are derived from the callback signature.

questions.question: Where are Click commands created?
important_facts: get_command_from_info constructs the Click-compatible command.

questions.question: How are help messages generated?
important_facts: TyperCommand and TyperGroup implement help formatting behavior.

questions.question: Where is shell completion implemented?
important_facts: shell_complete handles completion requests in typer/completion.py.

questions.question: How are boolean flags handled?
important_facts: get_click_param recognizes boolean options and configures flag behavior.
TyperOption provides runtime option behavior.

questions.question: Explain the `TyperOption` class.
important_facts: TyperOption is implemented in typer/core.py and extends Click parameter behavior.

questions.question: Explain the `TyperArgument` class.
important_facts: TyperArgument is implemented in typer/core.py and extends Click parameter behavior.

questions.question: How are callbacks executed?
important_facts: Typer registers callback metadata.
get_callback wraps callback invocation and conversion.

questions.question: How does Typer integrate with Click?
important_facts: Typer converts its command information into Click command objects.

questions.question: Where are default values processed?
important_facts: Function defaults become parameter metadata.
Parameter metadata is converted to Click defaults.

questions.question: Where is parameter validation implemented?
important_facts: ParameterInfo, OptionInfo, and ArgumentInfo store parameter constraints and metadata.

questions.question: Which module handles shell completion?
important_facts: Shell completion is handled in typer/completion.py.

questions.question: Where is the `run()` helper implemented?
important_facts: run is implemented in typer/main.py.

questions.question: Explain what `get_command_from_info()` does.
important_facts: It converts CommandInfo and parameter data into a Click-compatible TyperCommand.
